title: Getting a Leg Up on Body Language
heading: Getting a Leg Up on Body Language

structureSummary.part1: show why feet and legs reveal movement intention early
structureSummary.part2: explain common foot and leg patterns without face-only bias
structureSummary.part3: keep all readings contextual and modest

usageRules: Paraphrase-first. Support direction, readiness, withdrawal, blocking, stillness, and fidgeting as observable categories. Do not claim a single foot or leg cue proves desire, dislike, or deceit.
